Amazing Food & People
Jan 2020 • Couples
It’s rare to find eateries with great food in high volume areas that still value meeting customers and going above and beyond with service. Viet Spring Rolls definitely went above and beyond. The spring rolls were super fresh and flavorful but the main takeaway was how nice Pumpkin (I butchered the pronunciation of her real name so she opted for a nickname) and Thuỷ were. They taught us how to say ‘cheers’ in Vietnamese, corrected our pronunciation of some key words, wrote down suggestions for exploring Hanoi and overall were super cool. Thank you for a great experience!
